intro_h2: Bathroom Remodeling in Los Angeles County
intro: A well-built bathroom adds comfort every single day and real value at resale. Palm Crest Builders remodels bathrooms across Los Angeles County — primary suites, guest baths, and powder rooms — with proper waterproofing, quality tile work, and code-compliant plumbing and electrical. Whether you want a curbless walk-in shower, a freestanding soaking tub, or a complete layout change, we manage every trade as a single licensed team and build it to last.
benefits: Curbless and walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, and wet rooms
Professional waterproofing and tile — floors, walls, and niches
New vanities, countertops, lighting, and ventilation
Code-compliant plumbing and electrical, including GFCI protection
Aging-in-place options — grab bars, comfort-height fixtures, zero-threshold
Licensed, bonded, and insured — CA Class B general contractor

body_extra.heading: Waterproofing Is Everything
body_extra.text: The difference between a bathroom that lasts 20 years and one that fails in three is what happens behind the tile. We use modern waterproofing systems on shower pans, walls, and niches, slope pans correctly, and detail every transition. It's not the glamorous part of a remodel, but it's the part that protects your home from hidden water damage — and it's where we never cut corners.

faqs.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faqs.a: A standard bathroom takes 3–5 weeks on site. Primary-suite baths with layout changes or custom tile can run 5–7 weeks.

faqs.q: Can you convert my tub into a walk-in shower?
faqs.a: Yes — tub-to-shower conversions are one of our most requested projects. We reframe, re-plumb, waterproof, and tile to create a modern walk-in shower.

faqs.q: Do you offer accessible, aging-in-place bathrooms?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We build zero-threshold showers, add blocking for grab bars, and install comfort-height, ADA-friendly fixtures on request.
